newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RBA makes no policy announcement at morning window.
newsitem.headline: RBA makes no policy announcement at morning window.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of Australia made no announcement on interest rates at 9.30 a.m. (2330 GMT), the normal time it would adjust policy.
There had been speculation in financial markets the bank would cut its official cash rate today following a shock fall in May employment data reported on Thursday.
Official rates were last cut on May 23 when they fell to 5.5 percent from 6.0 percent.
